summary:
Our project consists of developing a 3D animated Mars environment using Blender and a game engine. We created 3D models and integrated them into an interactive environment where we can control robotic rovers and record different scenes. Through programming, we developed a menu that allows users to change environmental conditions, such as daytime, night time, and sandstorms.

Our project addresses the challenge by providing a creative and interactive way to simulate the Martian environment and tell a story demonstrating how rovers work. Instead of using traditional 2D animations, we chose 3D technology.

This project is important because it helps people better understand Mars, its environmental conditions, and the role of robotic exploration. It also demonstrates how 3D modeling, programming, and game development can be combined to communicate scientific concepts in an engaging and innovative way.
details: The final delivery is an animated video made with a Mars environment that we made using a game engine, first the 3d models were created in blender and then put all that on the engine, the coding permitted us to make a menu with the options to make the setting day, night, sandstorm , we can also move the rovers to record the scenes, our project is creative because our team considered using 3d animations instead of 2d or other type of elements, the benefit of having a game to do this is that we can do the scenes like we want
